Decision paths and data flows as text

Digitalisate and Transkribus lead via a documented export and verified import to the relevant TEI in the Editionsrepo. Alternative export routes converge during import acceptance. Independent research retains the reference to the basic status. Released data feed publishing house and technical frontend; typesetting corrections return checked. For archiving, image operation and further work own responsibilities are agreed.
